d.ko:
The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories.
About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

rv.t: 이 게임에 관심을 두신 분이라면, 아마 과거에 한 번쯤은 거쳐 가셨으리라 생각합니다. 윈도우 10/11 환경에서도 실행과 플레이에 문제가 없으며, 특유의 원초적인 재미 또한 여전합니다. 가벼운 마음으로 추억을 되새기며 짧게 즐기기에 더할 나위 없이 좋은 타이틀입니다.

i remember when i was little my dad downloaded this game on a old laptop and we used to play together in turns when someone dies, but i liked watching my dad play it more because i was scared of the aliens and the creepy music
In 2003 I played this for the graphics In 2026 I play it because my lizard brain loves seeing 5000 monsters turn into a fine red mist
